paper_title: Probing MeV to 90 GeV axion-like particles with LEP and LHC
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, read from figure description)
notes: Paper derives new LEP constraints on ALP-photon (and ALP-hypercharge) coupling from Z->2gamma and Z->3gamma decays, filling the MeV-10 GeV gap. The exclusion limits are only presented graphically in Fig. 4 (log-log plots); no numerical table of the exclusion contour is given. The only tabulated numbers (Tab. 1) are signal/background cross sections at fixed g=1e-4 GeV^-1, not exclusion limits. The data_points provided are rough order-of-magnitude estimates read from the figure region and should be treated as unreliable. LHC and FCC-ee curves are projections; the main LEP limit is a new observed constraint. Coupling type is AxionPhoton (g_agamma), though the paper also presents limits on the hypercharge coupling g_aBB. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.35, 3))
